notes: Direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/Cloudflare block hit; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, checked first per Rule 3). Site taxonomy read from server-rendered nav links on jcpenney.com/d/home-store, /d/home-store/home-decor and /d/home-store/kitchen-dining (category IDs cat...NNN visible in each link's id= param). PLP grids are client-rendered so no count is in the page HTML; counts instead came from the exact backend the frontend itself calls: JCPenney's search/browse config (embedded in each gallery page's inline JS, key 'constructorIO') points to Constructor.io at ac.cnstrc.com with public index key key_xT77K5VmpiVduqnj. Each category's own id (group_id) was queried via ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<id>?key=...&filters[item_type]=<x>, which returns response.total_num_results -- verified exact (not sampled/approximate) by spot cross-checking that a category's item_type facet counts sum to exactly its own total_num_results (Lighting: 745, Wall Decor item_type facets sum to ~2433) and that a direct filters[item_type] query reproduces the facet's reported count exactly (table lamps 207, vases 49 both confirmed). Scope: Lighting (Lighting & Lamps dept, all fixture types except ceiling fans/bulbs per Rule 0.2), Mirrors (main Mirrors category is 100% wall mirrors=134; Makeup/Vanity Mirrors=41 and Shower Mirrors=2 recovered from the Bath Accessories category under Rule 0.3 'all mirrors in scope, every type' -- these are a genuinely distinct item_type not present in the main Mirrors node), Wall Decor, Decorative Accessories (Home Accents category), Clocks (all 5 sub-types kept per brief's 'all types'), Picture Frames & Photo Display, Curtain Rods & Hardware (decorative-metal rods/finials/holdbacks-tiebacks only, not brackets/sliders/connectors/wands/extenders/hooks/rings which are functional mounting hardware), and Kitchen & Dining Tableware/Dinnerware, Serveware and Glassware & Drinkware (Rule: mugs/tumblers/stemware in scope as 'Glassware... functional', but Water Bottles/Travel Mugs/Insulated Tumblers excluded as travel-hydration gear, and cutlery/cookware/bakeware/small-appliances/table-linens excluded per the standard Kitchen exclusion). Excluded categories checked and dropped on merits: Artificial Florals & Plants, Wreaths, Garlands, Snow Globes, Floral Arrangements (all artificial/holiday), Candles & Home Fragrance jar candles/diffusers/oils/potpourri/room sprays/hand soaps (fragrance/personal care), Decorative Pillows incl. Throws (textile), Area Rugs/Runners/Accent Rugs (textile/floor covering), Plant Stands/Wreath Storage Bags (furniture/storage), Accent Furniture (2669 products, all tables/chairs/benches/ottomans -- no mirrors found there), Photo Albums/Digital Frames (storage/electronics), Salad Servers/Cheese Knives/Cake Servers/Spoon Rests/Casserole Dishes (utensils/cookware), Curtain Rod Brackets/Sliders/Connectors/Wands/Extenders/Hooks/Rings (mounting hardware). CROSS-CATEGORY DUPLICATES (Rule 0.6, same-listing-under-second-URL, dropped not double-counted): Wall Mirrors (134) appears identically in both the Mirrors category and as a Wall Decor item_type facet -- kept only under Mirrors. Wall Frames (19) and Collage Frames (1) appear identically in both Picture Frames & Albums and Wall Decor -- kept only under Picture Frames. Wall Clocks (81) appears identically in both Clocks and Wall Decor -- kept only under Clocks. Candle Sconces (3) appears identically in both Wall Decor and Candles & Home Fragrance -- kept only under Wall Decor. Candle Holders (85) appears identically in both Decorative Accessories(Home Accents) and Candles & Home Fragrance -- but this whole bucket was separately dropped by the holiday audit below. Serving Platters (115) and Serving Bowls (86) appear identically in both Dinnerware and Serveware -- kept only under Serveware; Dipping Bowls(4)/Egg Plates(1)/Cake Plates(1)/Sugar Bowls(1) likewise. Serving Pitchers (20) and Decanters (2) appear identically in both Serveware and Glassware & Drinkware -- kept only under Glassware & Drinkware. A dept-level 'Vases' nav shortcut (jcpenney.com/g/home-store/home-decor?item_type=vase+fillers|vases&id=cat100240022) is a pure facet re-cut of Decorative Accessories' own Vases/Vase Fillers types and was not re-emitted. HOLIDAY-CONTAMINATION AUDIT (material finding this pass): JCPenney's Home Decor catalog is heavily stocked with Fall/Halloween/Thanksgiving/Christmas seasonal SKUs as of this Aug 2026 snapshot. Several item_type facet buckets that read as generic decor names are in fact dominated by holiday merchandise once product titles are inspected (Rule: 'mixed roll-ups: drop, dont pad -- inspect actual titles'). Method: for every candidate leaf, queried the category's own 'event' facet (christmas/halloween/thanksgiving/easter/etc tags Constructor.io itself applies to each SKU) and computed what fraction of the bucket carries an explicit holiday-event tag; spot-verified against actual product titles for the largest buckets. Buckets >=50% holiday-tagged were dropped entirely (not padded with an estimated 'clean' remainder, which would be a guess): String Lights 317 (82.6%, titles are Kurt Adler Christmas string lights e.g. 'Candy Cane With Holly Leaves'), Icicle Lights 15, Net Lights 10, Snowfall Lights 3 (all Kurt Adler/Northlight Christmas exterior lighting), Tabletop Decor 439 (90.9%, titles e.g. 'Halloween Tabletop Decor'/'Lighted Christmas Tabletop Decor'), Figurines 375 (64.5%, titles are Halloween/Thanksgiving gnomes and turkeys), Decorative Lanterns 40 (62.5%, titles include Halloween skull/spider lanterns), Candle Holders 85 (51.8%, titles include Fall/Christmas/Reindeer themed holders), Flameless Candles 20 (95%, titles e.g. 'Merry' and 'Snowy Woodland' prints), Wall Signs 86 (77.9%), Marquee Lights 14 (100%, titles are 'Joy'/'Eek'/'Merry Christmas' LED signs), Appetizer Plates 62 (51.6%), Dessert Plates 30 (86.7%), Cheese Board Sets 36 (52.8%), Teapots 20 (65%), Tiered Servers 10 (100%), Chip & Dip Sets 8 (50%). Buckets below 50% were kept at their full total_num_results as a normal decor category (e.g. Dinnerware Sets 27%, Coffee Mugs 36%, Serving Platters 38%, Canvas Art 11%, Wall Mirrors 0.7%) -- minority holiday-occasion cross-tagging (housewarming/wedding/hostess-gift tags included in a raw all-events count are NOT treated as holiday; only christmas/halloween/thanksgiving/easter/st-patricks/hanukkah/4th-of-july/mardi-gras/new-years/patriotic tags counted toward the 50% test) is normal for any general decor line and does not disqualify it. This audit could not be run exhaustively on every tiny sub-count across the whole site given time constraints, so a small amount of residual seasonal contamination may remain in the kept 1-2-digit buckets; this is judged immaterial to overall accuracy given the sub-50% threshold and spot title checks on the largest ones. No qty required a null+MANUAL REVIEW flag -- every kept leaf resolved to an exact Constructor.io total_num_results.
